mapper.select: SELECT d.driver_idx, d.driver_id, d.driver_pwd, d.driver_name, d.driver_region, d.driver_contact, d.driver_birthdate, d.driver_gender, d.created_at, d.driver_lat, d.driver_lon, d.display_addr, d.admin_idx, c.car_number FROM tb_driver d LEFT JOIN tb_car c ON d.driver_idx = c.driver_idx WHERE d.driver_lat IS NOT NULL AND d.driver_lon IS NOT NULL

SELECT driver_idx, driver_id, driver_pwd, driver_name, driver_region, driver_contact, driver_birthdate, driver_gender, created_at, driver_lat, driver_lon, display_addr, admin_idx FROM tb_driver WHERE driver_idx = #{driverIdx} LIMIT 1
